ranks: The need-keys recheck list R7 (Phase 1 step 2)

authored.name: King T'Challa // Black Panther, Hope Enduring
The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

blocked.name: Maddening Hex
blocked.why: The d6 roll and damage are expressible; 'then attach this Aura to another one of your opponents chosen at random' isn't: attach can't move an Aura to a random other opponent.

blocked.name: Bucknard's Everfull Purse
blocked.why: The d4 and Treasures are expressible; 'the player to your right gains control of this artifact' names a seat no effect can.

blocked.name: Comet, Stellar Pup
blocked.why: The 6 row's 'you may activate Comet's loyalty ability two more times this turn', and the 4-5 row's damage to a creature or player chosen as it resolves, not targeted.

blocked.name: Component Pouch
blocked.why: 'Add two mana of different colors': add-mana's oneOf with amount 2 allows the same colour twice.

blocked.name: Lae'zel's Acrobatics
blocked.why: Exiling all your nontoken creatures untargeted and returning 'those cards' at the next end step (and the 10-20 row's return-then-exile-again) isn't expressible.

blocked.name: Luck Bobblehead
blocked.why: 'If you rolled 6 exactly seven times, you win the game': no condition counts the dice that showed a given result.

blocked.name: Neverwinter Hydra
blocked.why: 'As this creature enters, roll X d6. It enters with that many +1/+1 counters': an enters-with-counters replacement can't roll.

blocked.name: Strength-Testing Hammer
blocked.why: 'If it has the greatest power or is tied among creatures on the battlefield': source-greatest reads the Equipment, not the equipped creature, and greatestAmongItsController is per controller.

blocked.name: Sword of Hours
blocked.why: 'If the result is greater than the damage dealt or the result is 12' compares the roll with the trigger's damage; no condition can.

blocked.name: The Deck of Many Things
blocked.why: The 20 row's untargeted 'creature card from any graveyard', and 'when that creature dies, its owner loses the game'.

blocked.name: Treasure Chest
blocked.why: The 20 row's search: 'if it's an artifact card, you may put it onto the battlefield; otherwise into your hand' — search-library has one destination.

blocked.name: Vexing Puzzlebox
blocked.why: 'Whenever you roll one or more dice, put charge counters equal to the result': the rolls-dice trigger value is the natural total, but the ruling counts the result after modifiers.

blocked.name: Wand of Wonder
blocked.why: 'Cast up to X instant and/or sorcery spells from among cards exiled this way': cast-now's repeat has no up-to-X cap across every opponent's exile.

blocked.name: Wyll's Reversal
blocked.why: 'Target spell or ability with one or more targets': the stack target has singleTarget but no 'with one or more targets'.

blocked.name: Fighter Class
blocked.why: Level 2's 'equip abilities you activate cost {2} less': abilityCostModification can't single out equip abilities. Level 3's forced block exists (block-if-able).

blocked.name: Grievous Wound
blocked.why: 'Enchanted player can't gain life' (no static reaches the enchanted player) and 'whenever enchanted player is dealt damage' (any damage, not only combat).

blocked.name: Samwise the Stouthearted
blocked.why: 'Permanent card in your graveyard that was put there from the battlefield this turn': only the from-library marker exists.

blocked.name: Sauron's Ransom
blocked.why: An opponent separates the top four into a face-down and a face-up pile; you choose one: no such decision.

blocked.name: Witch-king of Angmar
blocked.why: 'Each opponent sacrifices a creature that dealt combat damage to you this turn': no filter for creatures that dealt you combat damage this turn.

blocked.name: Bonecrusher Giant
blocked.why: Stomp's 'Damage can't be prevented this turn' has no effect.

blocked.name: Fated Firepower
blocked.why: The damage replacement's plus is a fixed number, not the fire counters on this enchantment; and its ruling lets the damaged player order it against prevention.

blocked.name: Inquisitor's Flail
blocked.why: A damage replacement can't name the equipped creature as source or recipient.

blocked.name: Kor Haven
blocked.why: 'Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt by target attacking creature this turn': prevent-all-combat-damage's by is a filter, not a target.

blocked.name: Pariah
blocked.why: 'All damage that would be dealt to you is dealt to enchanted creature instead': no redirection of damage to a player onto an object.

blocked.name: Pariah's Shield
blocked.why: The same redirection onto the equipped creature.

blocked.name: Questing Beast
blocked.why: 'Combat damage that would be dealt by creatures you control can't be prevented' has no static; the rest of the card is expressible.

blocked.name: Sokrates, Athenian Teacher
blocked.why: The granted until-end-of-turn prevention whose follow-up has the creature's controller and the damaged player each draw half: no replacement can be granted, and the follow-up can't name the damaged player.

blocked.name: Take the Bait
blocked.why: 'Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt to you and planeswalkers you control this turn': the one-shot prevention can't be limited to you and your planeswalkers.

blocked.name: Temple Altisaur
blocked.why: 'Prevent all but 1 of that damage' has no prevention shape.

blocked.name: The Rollercrusher Ride
blocked.why: Its ruling lets the damaged player order the doubling against prevention (rule 616.1); the engine always applies multipliers first.

blocked.name: Krark's Thumb
blocked.why: 'If you would flip a coin, instead flip two coins and ignore one': no coin-flip replacement.

blocked.name: Mirror March
blocked.why: untilLose applies won once per win; the card counts the wins and then creates all the copies at once (the ruling).

blocked.name: Rakdos, the Showstopper
blocked.why: A flip for each non-Demon/Devil/Imp creature, the losers destroyed simultaneously.

blocked.name: Ral Zarek
blocked.why: The -7's five uncalled flips have no winner; flip-coin always has one and fires wins-coin-flip triggers, which the ruling forbids.

blocked.name: Paradox Haze
blocked.why: additional-upkeep-steps works on its controller's own turn; the card adds an upkeep for the enchanted player during their first upkeep each turn.

blocked.name: Final Act
blocked.why: 'Each opponent loses all counters': remove-player-counters takes one kind and can't remove energy.

blocked.name: Hot Pursuit
blocked.why: 'As long as this enchantment remains on the battlefield, that creature is also goaded', and 'if two or more players have lost the game'.

blocked.name: Dust of Moments
blocked.why: Removing or adding two time counters on each permanent and each suspended card: no effect reaches every permanent and suspended card at once.

blocked.name: Expropriate
blocked.why: for-each-vote exists, but 'choose a permanent owned by the voter' has no filter (ownedBy is only you or opponent).

blocked.name: Innkeeper's Talent
blocked.why: Level 3: 'if you would put counters on a permanent or player' — would-add-counter reaches only permanents you control, not counters you put on others' permanents or on players.

blocked.name: Sorcerer Class
blocked.why: Mana spendable only on instants, sorceries or a Class level (abilityOf a Class would allow its non-level abilities), and the cast spell as the damage's source.

blocked.name: Fraying Sanity
blocked.why: No turn stat counts cards put into a graveyard from anywhere.

blocked.name: Tenuous Truce
blocked.why: attacks-player counts attacked players only, never their planeswalkers, and the trigger runs both ways.

blocked.name: Chaos Dragon
blocked.why: Each player rolling and comparing results, and the per-opponent attack restriction.

blocked.name: Reckless Endeavor
blocked.why: roll-dice can't choose one of two results.

blocked.name: Wyll, Blade of Frontiers
blocked.why: No 'roll that many dice plus one and ignore the lowest' replacement.

blocked.name: Sasaya, Orochi Ascendant // Sasaya's Essence
blocked.why: The Essence's extra mana per other same-name land, and the front's 'seven or more land cards in your hand' (hand-size has no filter).

blocked.name: Kozilek's Command
blocked.why: 'Target player scries X': scry has no target.

blocked.name: Lignify
blocked.why: Losing all abilities exists only as one-shot effects, not a static.

blocked.name: Not of This World
blocked.why: The stack target can't require a spell or ability that targets a permanent you control, and nothing keys a cost reduction to it.

blocked.name: Out of Time
blocked.why: No this-way count of creatures phased out.

blocked.name: Heartwood Crafter // Soul Tether
blocked.why: ManaRestriction has no 'not to cast spells from your hand' clause.

blocked.name: Stensian Sanguinist // Exsanguinate
blocked.why: The delayed combat-damage watch lasts the turn, so a second combat would prepare it again.

blocked.name: Nazgûl
blocked.why: 'A deck can have up to nine cards named Nazgûl' isn't a deck-validation exception.

blocked.name: One Ring to Rule Them All
blocked.why: Chapter I's Ring-bearer power is an aggregate sum now, but chapter III's 'each opponent loses 1 life for each creature card in that player's graveyard' counts the controller's graveyard even inside for-each-player.

blocked.name: The Ring Goes South
blocked.why: reveal-until-count has no tapped option.

blocked.name: Infesting Radroach
blocked.why: The cards-milled event has no trigger listening to it.

blocked.name: Mariposa Military Base
blocked.why: No 'you may have it enter tapped; if you do …' choice.

blocked.name: Mirelurk Queen
blocked.why: No trigger for 'one or more nonland cards are milled'.

blocked.name: Screeching Scorchbeast
blocked.why: No trigger for 'one or more nonland cards are milled'.

blocked.name: Strong, the Brutish Thespian
blocked.why: The rad ability's life loss is a plain lose-life, so loss from radiation can't be told apart or replaced.

blocked.name: Tato Farmer
blocked.why: putIntoGraveyardFromLibraryThisTurn also matches surveilled cards, which the ruling excludes.

blocked.name: The Master, Transcendent
blocked.why: The same milled-only filter, and returning it as a green 3/3 Mutant.

blocked.name: Charred Foyer // Warped Space
blocked.why: alternativeCostForSpells has no once-per-turn or cast-from-exile limit.

blocked.name: Dazzling Theater // Prop Room
blocked.why: Convoke is read only from a card's printed flag.

blocked.name: Dollmaker's Shop // Porcelain Gallery
blocked.why: The attacks-player trigger has no attacker filter for 'non-Toy'.

blocked.name: Fear of Sleep Paralysis
blocked.why: Nothing stops stun counters from being removed.

blocked.name: Polluted Cistern // Dim Oubliette
blocked.why: Counting card types exists for a resolution's own cards, not a trigger's batch.

blocked.name: Secret Arcade // Dusty Parlor
blocked.why: A type-adding static doesn't reach spells on the stack.

blocked.name: Walk-In Closet // Forgotten Cellar
blocked.why: No 'if a card would be put into your graveyard this turn, exile it instead' player effect.

blocked.name: Jhoira of the Ghitu
blocked.why: The effect can't refer to the card the cost exiled from hand.

blocked.name: Doc Samson, Super Psychiatrist
blocked.why: A planeswalker's +N loyalty cost still skips the counter replacements (other cost counters now pass through them), and the 'you put' limit isn't modelled.

blocked.name: Pir, Imaginative Rascal
blocked.why: Only the +N loyalty cost still skips the counter replacements.

blocked.name: Winding Constrictor
blocked.why: changePlayerCounters applies no replacement to counters a player gets.
